reason: I like trying new tools and the first task is free with the founder helping, so I would run one small pilot for fun. I would not put real money in until I have seen how the judge scores things.
objection: It is unaudited, invite-only and I have to fund with USDC on Solana. I have to justify every dollar I spend on freelancers, and winner-takes-all means I pay 55 for one result while the rest is scored reports. I also need to be sure an AI judge can score copy fairly.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a few public example tasks with the rubric, the scores and the written reasons, and a way to pay without me setting up a wallet and bridging funds myself.
